mapper.insert: INSERT INTO refresh_tokens (user_id, refresh_token, previous_refresh_token) VALUES (#{userId}, #{refresh_token}, null)
mapper.update: MERGE INTO refresh_tokens AS t USING (SELECT #{userId} AS userId, #{refreshToken} AS refresh_token) AS s ON t.userId = s.userId WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET refresh_token = s.refresh_token WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (userId, refresh_token, previous_refresh_token) VALUES (s.userId, s.refresh_token, null)
mapper.select: SELECT 1 FROM refresh_tokens WHERE userId = #{userId} AND refresh_token = #{refreshToken}
